versions.name: Arrow of Light Trail to Troop Resident Camp at Hale

features.note: Every campsite sits near a bathroom facility with running water and hot showers.
Each campsite has access to a power outlet.
An indoor climbing wall in the dining hall, used for daily climbing races.
Kitchen-prepared meals with a full salad bar.
Campsites share shower and toilet facilities close by.
A health officer is on duty around the clock.
Canvas wall tents on wooden platforms, two participants per tent, cots provided.
Swim checks are run at the pool on arrival.
Range sports form part of the programme; firearms are confined to designated ranges.
Trading post with laundry facilities behind it.
Lake activities, for which water shoes are required.

versions.summary: Arrow of Light resident camp for rising fifth graders at Hale Scout Reservation, offered by Indian Nations Council in Talihina, Oklahoma.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
